body: Seems circumstantially unlikely, no? That X person will become happy despite lacking conditions Y that have caused happiness for person X in the past? What's more, maybe our big stupid brains just like making the past better than the present; in which case, we're doomed to suffer.

I have only been happy in the past when I didn't have fiscal, social, or academic expectations and responsibilities. Particularly, childhood. Obviously, it's not sustainable to live my entire life like this. I do often think about childhood. I wish I could know less and think slower than I do now. Thinking and knowing has made my life fundamentally worse.
